caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress with a fitted bodice and wide sleeves. The dress is primarily a light gray color, rendered with shading to convey the texture and folds of the fabric. The dress features a row of small blue buttons that run down the center front of the bodice. The collar is white with a lace-like pattern and has a small decorative brooch or pin at the throat. Blue decorative trim with a gold pattern accents the edges of the sleeves—both around the cuffs and roughly halfway up each sleeve, as well as at the ends of the upper arm section. The composition centers the dress on a plain, cream or light beige background with no additional objects or details present in the drawing. The dress has no visible mannequin or person inside it.
title: Dress
